name: 33408 · N Palm Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33408 (N Palm Beach) has 196 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33408 (N Palm Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33408 (N Palm Beach) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
